title: Compress MIMO output boundary heads while retaining shared trunk and multi-input training
hypothesis: A per-member Mirror phase can replace MIMO member-specific binary output heads over a shared trunk with lower total serialized payload while retaining member NLL/diversity and one batched inference.
physical_object: shared frozen 16x64 ReLU trunk plus per-member MIMO output heads
mirror_coordinate: one angle per member rotating two coordinates of the shared 64D output head

task.teacher: member heads are planar rotations of one shared head; labels sampled Bernoulli logistic

controls: shared trunk plus full MIMO member-head bank
shared trunk plus Mirror phase head views
shared trunk plus generic rank-2 basis/coefficient heads
shared trunk plus one shared output head

development.metric: total payload, head payload, member NLL/ECE/accuracy/disagreement, one-batch latency including trunk/view reconstruction

storage.authority: actual deterministic serialized inference payload bytes
paid_objects: full head bank or shared basis/head

success_gate: Mirror NLL within .02 and disagreement within .02 of MIMO; total payload <=0.80x MIMO and <=0.90x generic coefficients; retain one batch call.
failure_gate: Total payload gate misses, quality/diversity misses, or generic control matches within 10% bytes and quality.
boundaries: linear output-head screen, not deep MIMO reproduction
